entities.name: Jorge Castañeda y Álvarez de la Rosa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jorge Castañeda y Álvarez de la Rosa was a Mexican diplomat. He served as Secretary of Foreign Affairs from April 1979 to 30 November 1982, during the administration of José López Portillo. His son, Jorge Castañeda Gutman, was foreign secretary from 2000 to 2003.
